AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip10: A Darkness Imp watches over your progression (10 XP secretly awarded by the GM). +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip10: At the 10th point of Darkness, a voice rises from your shadow: an Imp. It can advise you during Invocations and opens the path to conjuring minor Demons (Opalins).
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip20: The dreams of the past return under a blood moon. Some particularly harrowing nights: -2 to all physical actions the next day. +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip20: Your Imp can evolve using your experience points. +1 stat = 2 XP, +1 skill = 1 XP. Max skills = your INT, max score 5.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip30: A 1st or 2nd Circle Demon bursts from every orifice of the Darkness-bearer to guide (and annoy) them. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip30: The Mischievous Demon bursting from your body grants you the key to Invoking Second Circle creatures.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip40: At night, the body follows the outline of shadows while sleepwalking. WIL DIF 20 roll required to avoid falling. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip50: Nights without real sleep, filled with nightmares and sleepwalking episodes. Sleep is no longer restorative. +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip55: Animosity manifesting as violence toward a type of individual (opposite sex, Decan, Season, caste…). +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip60: Libido oriented toward frankly perverse sexual practices (sadism, absurd forms of relationships…). +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip65: At full moon, an irresistible need to trace shadow patterns in one's flesh with a blade. The pain is enough to disrupt concentration. +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip70: Hideous demonic double of the Darkness-bearer. Conjuration DIF -5. Can transfer emotions and wounds. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip70: The flashes perceived through the Twin's eyes allow you to perceive Darkness more deeply. You can invoke Third Circle Demons.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip75: Obsessed with darkness and shadow, avoids illuminated areas. Vision decreases in full light (no technical consequences). +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip75: Vision in total darkness. Develop the 'Sense of Darkness' skill. Penalties from dim or absent lighting are ignored.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip78: Constant sneaky presence (ghost, specter, beast…) generating paranoid hallucinations. Permanent distraction is a fact. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip78: You see wandering souls of the dead and can speak with them. Roll Blackness + 1d10 against variable DIF depending on whether the dead person is willing to speak.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip81: All senses altered: darker colors, screams from the Abyss, smell of putrefaction, rancid taste, touch as cold as marble. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip81: Roll Blackness + Demonology + 1d10 against DIF 15 to automatically detect any demonic creature. Does not protect against their illusions.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip84: Blood is replaced by a black molasses. The Advocatus Diaboli grows suspicious; Demons won't hesitate to contract directly. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip87: Monstrous body resembling a Demon. Risk of being mistaken for a fleeing Demon and hunted by the Abyss Minotaurs. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip90: Recovers 10 Perfidy points, possibly accompanied by the corresponding Afflictions and Boons. (No black bonus.)
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip92: Dark growth taking the form of an obsidian face on the body, expressing itself through the mouth. Can be a confidant or annoying passenger. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip92: The Siamese's intelligence opens to you the prospects of Invoking Fourth Circle Demons... at your own risk.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip94: Animals react with hostility or fear. In packs or any gathering, they will attack. +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip96: The shadow no longer obeys the body or light; it acts according to emotions and can simulate shadow objects, attack other shadows. +1 Mind black.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip98: Connected to Darkness by bonds so strong that in danger, a portal to the Abyss opens through the belly. Permanently deforms the body. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip98: Your inner portal allows you to call Obsidians, the only type that still eluded you. The Invocation requires encircling your own shadow with black ink.
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip99: A High Devil has spotted you and watches closely, placing a physical mark that creates strange deformations in your silhouette. +1 Body black.
AGONE.TenebresBienfaitTooltip99: Roll Blackness + Vigilance + 1d10 against DIF 20 to sense Darkness in an object or being. Margin x 10 = accuracy in % (MR 10 = exact figure).
AGONE.TenebresPalierTooltip100: Darkness-bearer at maximum potential, called Fallen. A High Devil has an empathic link and can converse telepathically. Most of the time in madness.
